name: @mallinoi/cucumber-grow-mobile
description: 말린오이 오이키우기 독립 iOS·Android 게임 앱

scripts.assets:generate: capacitor-assets generate --assetPath assets/splash-art --android --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#9bd58d' --splashBackgroundColor '#dff3dc' --logoSplashScale 0.75 && capacitor-assets generate --assetPath assets/app-icon --android --ios
scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios:sim: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
